answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with delayed settlement: every trade's payment is held in escrow until counterparties attest delivery, like water slowly reaching an oasis rather than flooding at once. A single fake identity is a harmless relic, but a ring of clones cannot recycle the same capital quickly — each clone's funds stay locked through the whole delay, and a dispute freezes the whole cluster. The delay acts as a prism, splitting one attacker's capital across time so mass fraud needs mass locked money, not just mass accounts.
